The restaurant offers in-store collection and home delivery, with its own website setting out a delivery radius of up to 10 kilometres from the restaurant, so it also serves diners further out in the southern suburbs who would rather eat at home. The karaoke rooms set it apart from a standard Korean restaurant, giving groups a reason to stay on for a sing-along after a meal.

The restaurant trades from 103 Main Road, Claremont, and suits diners looking for Korean cuisine, Korean barbecue and a social night out with karaoke, whether dining in, collecting or having a meal delivered.

Kwikspar Glencairn is a supermarket in Glencairn Shopping Centre selling groceries and everyday food products, with particular emphasis on fresh produce, fresh meat and freshly baked goods.

The store describes itself as part of the local Simon's Town-area community rather than simply another supermarket branch, and its range leans toward the fresh departments, from the bakery and butchery counters to produce, alongside the everyday groceries shoppers need for a quick top-up or a full weekly shop.

The supermarket trades from Glencairn Shopping Centre, on the corner of Birkenhead Road and Glencairn Freeway, and serves the Glencairn and surrounding Simon's Town-area community looking for fresh produce, meat, baked goods and everyday groceries close to home.

Noordhoek Village Tack Shop is an equestrian store in Noordhoek Farm Village, opened 15 years ago to supply quality riding gear at affordable prices. Inside, bridles hang from the ceiling, riding crops line the counter and polished saddles sit on hooks, alongside numnahs, jodhpurs, boots and riding hats for all ages from brands including Colt and Equiline.

The shop was started out of a passion for horse riding, and it serves the local community of riders who keep their own horses near Noordhoek's long stretch of beach, as well as visitors drawn in by the scent of leather. From bridles to handbags, the range covers most of what a horse and rider need.

The shop is on the corner of Main Road and Village Lane in Noordhoek, open longer hours in summer, and suits riders, stable owners and anyone after genuine equestrian gear in a setting close to Chapman's Peak and the beach.

Ocean Fresh Fisheries in Kraaifontein is a fish and chips restaurant known for its hake, gatsbys and fish and chips, alongside rolls, steaks and other meat dishes. The restaurant trades from the 1 Stop and Shop Centre on the corner of Conroy Street, offering both dine-in and takeaway.

Reviewers describe the restaurant as busy, with good prices, fast service and generous portions of old-style fish and chips, and visitors frequently mention the friendly staff. The restaurant has an average Google rating of 4.6 out of 5 from more than 200 ratings, and the site offers free parking for customers.

The restaurant suits a quick takeaway meal or a sit-down lunch or dinner in Kraaifontein for anyone after straightforward fish and chips or a gatsby.

Parks Restaurant in Constantia, formerly known as 95 at Parks, is an Italian restaurant that describes its food as time-honoured northern Italian cuisine with contemporary refinement. The restaurant is set in a historic homestead that has been thoughtfully refreshed, keeping its timeless charm alongside a more modern finish.

Diners can eat in the main restaurant, unwind in the Bar and Atrium over after-work drinks or pre-dinner cocktails, or host an intimate gathering in the private Heritage Dining Room. The wine list features an exceptional selection of South Africa's finest wines, including bottles aimed at serious collectors, and the space is set up for private celebrations and larger functions.

The restaurant is on Constantia Main Road and suits a special-occasion Italian dinner, a private function, or after-work drinks in a heritage setting.

Current directory information categorises the branch specifically for men's, women's and children's clothing, rather than just listing it generically under the PEP chain, giving a clearer sense of the range carried at this particular store than the brand name alone.

The store is in Mandalay Mall on Swartklip Road, Khayelitsha, and suits men, women and families in the area looking for affordable, everyday clothing and footwear close to home, without needing to travel further into Cape Town.

The store trades from Shop 2B & 3B in The Stables Shopping Centre, Potsdam Road, Dunoon, and suits families and value-conscious shoppers in the area looking for everyday clothing, homeware or tech at affordable prices.

The branch stocks the everyday groceries, fresh produce and household essentials shoppers expect from the Pick n Pay name, built around the QualiSave promise of keeping prices low on the basics.

Trading from inside Vangate Mall on Vanguard Drive, the branch serves shoppers from Athlone, Bridgetown and the surrounding Cape Town communities who use the mall for their regular grocery run alongside the centre's other retailers. Roman's Pizza Okavango Crossing is a pizza takeaway and delivery outlet on the corner of Langeberg Road and Okavango Road in the Okavango Crossing shopping centre, Kraaifontein. The branch makes its pizza dough fresh in-store every day, and like other Roman's Pizza outlets, it specialises in the pan-base pizza the chain built its name on, served alongside the usual range of toppings and sides.

Customers can order for sit-down dining, takeaway or delivery, making the branch a convenient option for a quick family meal or a pizza dropped off at home without a trip into town.

Trading seven days a week from 10am to 9pm, the branch gives Kraaifontein residents a straightforward stop for an affordable, freshly made pizza close to home.

Sheet Street Golden Acre is a branch of the Sheet Street homeware chain, trading from Shop C59 in Golden Acre Shopping Centre on the corner of Strand and Adderley Streets in the Cape Town CBD. The branch's own listing on the chain's store locator carries its current daily trading hours, confirming it as an operating outlet within the centre.

The store stocks Sheet Street's usual range of bedroom, bathroom and living essentials, from duvet covers, sheeting and blankets to curtains, comforters and other household decor pieces, alongside the seasonal and promotional ranges the chain rotates through its stores.

Based in the heart of the CBD among Golden Acre's other retailers, the store suits shoppers looking to pick up homeware and bedding basics while already in the city centre for work, transport or other errands.

Simon's Town Museum collects and exhibits the cultural history of Simon's Town, covering the town's long connections with the Dutch East India Company, the Royal Navy and the forced removals that reshaped the community under apartheid. The museum is housed in The Residency, a building raised in 1777 as a winter residence for the Dutch East India Company's Governor, giving the collection a historic home that is itself part of the story it tells.

The museum was established in 1977 and moved into The Residency in 1982, and alongside its permanent displays it offers school and group tours as well as presentations for visiting parties.

Based on Court Road in Simon's Town, the museum suits visitors, tourists, schoolchildren, researchers and anyone curious about the naval, colonial and social history that shaped this corner of the Cape Peninsula.

Sinenjongo High School is a public, no-fee secondary school in Joe Slovo Park, Milnerton, serving grades 8 to 12 under the Western Cape Education Department. Classified as a Quintile 4 school, it enrols around 1,570 learners taught by a staff of about 50 teachers, reflecting its role as one of the larger secondary schools serving this part of Milnerton.

Alongside its core academic curriculum, the school's programme covers STEM education, academic support and career guidance to help learners through to matric, together with broader learner development through arts and culture, sport and extracurricular activities outside the classroom.

The school is based at 11A Freedom Way in Joe Slovo Park, and serves secondary-school learners from Joe Slovo Park and the surrounding Milnerton communities looking for a full academic and extracurricular programme through to Grade 12.

Sorbet Steenberg Village offers a full menu of beauty treatments spanning facials and skincare, body treatments, hair removal, makeup and massage. The treatment list runs from acne facials, chemical peels, dermaplaning and microdermabrasion through to body sculpting and cellulite treatment, eyebrow threading, bridal and event makeup, and back massage, giving clients a wide spread of options under one roof.

The salon operates as part of the national Sorbet network, a brand built around professional, treatment-led beauty care delivered from neighbourhood locations rather than a single flagship store.

Found in Shop F3 of Steenberg Village Centre on Reddam Avenue, the salon serves clients from Steenberg, Tokai and the surrounding southern suburbs, and is open seven days a week, including Sunday afternoons, for anyone who prefers to book a treatment over the weekend.

South End Hardware & Gas on Lower Gordon's Bay Road in Strand is a hardware store stocking homeware, outdoor, plumbing, security and power tool ranges alongside its gas and gas accessories line. The power tools range includes cordless and corded options from brands such as DeWalt, Makita, Stanley, Fragram and Ingco, covering drilling, cutting, grinding, sanding and demolition work.

The plumbing section covers shower, bath, basin and sink mixers and taps, while the security range includes door and safe locks. The homeware side stretches from branded kitchenware and appliances to braai equipment, gardening tools, pressure washers and vacuum cleaners, with a smaller apparel and vintage and antiques section alongside the trade stock.

The store suits DIY customers, tradespeople and households in Strand looking for building materials, tools, plumbing fittings or gas supplies under one roof.

Spec-Savers Goodwood Mall is an optometry practice offering professional eye tests, eye-care screening and eyewear advice to patients in Goodwood. Using modern eye-testing technology, the practice screens for underlying conditions such as glaucoma, cataracts and macular degeneration as part of a standard eye examination, rather than only checking for a new spectacle prescription.

The branch opened in December 2022, making it one of the newer additions to Goodwood Mall's retail line-up, and it operates as part of the wider Spec-Savers network with the backing of the brand's testing standards and eyewear range.

Trading from Shop S02 in Goodwood Mall on Dirkie Uys Street, the practice serves patients of all ages in Goodwood and the surrounding northern suburbs who need an eye examination, vision correction or help choosing frames and lenses.

Standard Bank Eerste Rivier Service Centre is a banking branch that operates as one of Standard Bank's cashless branches, meaning everyday transactions are handled digitally rather than over a teller counter. It gives customers in Eerste River a dedicated banking point for account services, card and account queries, and access to the bank's self-service and digital banking tools.

As a cashless-format branch, it reflects Standard Bank's shift toward digital-first banking at smaller service points, rather than operating as a full-service branch with cash handling on site.

Trading from the Eerste River City Centre in Eerste River, the branch serves Standard Bank customers in the area who need everyday banking support without travelling to a larger, full-service branch.

Stellenberg High School in Bellville is guided by its FIRE values of Faith, Integrity, Responsibility and Excellence, summed up in its motto Vivat Scientia, or Let Knowledge Live. The school's foyer holds a carved image of embracing hands in warm colours and a soft wood finish, meant as a reminder that every learner should feel loved and treasured at the school.

The never-ending ring of diverse hands in the artwork is described as a symbol of the school's unity and diversity, reaching out to support and embrace staff, learners, supporters and the wider parent community. The school describes itself as a balanced, dynamic and excellent environment that welcomes a diverse community of people.

The school stands in the northern suburbs of Bellville, with Table Mountain in the background, and suits families looking for a school where academic performance sits alongside a strong sense of community and shared values.

SWEAT1000 is a boutique group fitness studio on the third floor of The Point in Sea Point, built around a treadmill-based interval training concept. The name stands for Specialised Weight Endurance Athletic Training, with the 1000 referring to the number of calories the workout is designed to burn, combining interval training, functional training, core stability work, athletic training and agility work in one class.

The studio uses the FreeMotion Incline Trainer treadmill, which inclines to 30 degrees rather than the usual 15, based on research showing that walking at a steeper incline burns more calories from fat than running on a flat surface. Classes are regularly updated with new movements, and sessions include live DJs, specially mixed remixes and laser and disco lighting to keep the format fresh.

The studio suits anyone looking for a structured, high-energy treadmill and functional training class in Sea Point, rather than a traditional gym floor workout.

Tafelsig Primary School is a public, no-fee primary school on Olifantshoek Avenue in Tafelsig, Mitchells Plain, teaching the CAPS curriculum to around 1,187 learners under a staff of about 31 educators. As a Quintile 4 institution, the school receives government funding per learner to cover its operational and teaching costs, keeping it free of charge for the families it serves.

Beyond the classroom, the school runs sports, arts and other learner activities alongside ongoing teacher development initiatives, documented through its own current social-media presence rather than a dedicated school website.

Serving primary-school learners from Tafelsig and the surrounding Mitchells Plain community, the school suits families looking for a no-fee CAPS primary school with an active extracurricular programme alongside its core academic teaching.

Based in Khayelitsha, the store serves adult customers in the area buying alcoholic beverages for home consumption, whether as part of a regular grocery trip or a standalone stop.

The clinic treats dogs, cats and pets of all shapes and sizes, covering consultations, vaccinations, parasite control, dentistry and general, soft-tissue and orthopaedic surgery.

In-house blood testing, digital X-ray facilities, ultrasound and a full dental operating unit let the team diagnose and treat pets quickly on site. The clinic also runs a retail store selling treats, toys and premium pet food for healthy pets as well as those in for treatment.

The practice is on Blaauwberg Road in Table View, offers walk-in consultations, and suits pet owners who want vaccinations, routine check-ups or more involved veterinary care from one clinic.

vida e caffe Paarden Eiland is a branch of the vida e caffe coffee shop chain, serving the brand's espresso-based coffee, cold drinks and all-day food menu from inside the TDC Campus office park. The branch gives the mixed office and business community around Marine Drive a coffee counter to stop at between meetings or on the way in and out of work.

As with other vida e caffe branches, the focus stays on quick, counter-service coffee and light food rather than a sit-down restaurant menu, fitting the pace of a working business park rather than a leisure destination.

Zone Fitness Willowbridge is a gym in Willowbridge Shopping Centre in Bellville, in the fast-growing Tygervalley area near the Tyger Valley shopping mall, a lake and a storm-water waterfall. The branch is fitted with modern, easy-to-use equipment for a mix of cardio and strength training.
